concerns.text: T105 invokes a 'ratified Plan Override' that computes VIF scores and clusters but 'do NOT remove features; feature count must be unchanged'. FR-007 mandates iterative VIF pruning (remove highest-VIF feature while VIF > 5.0, retain ≥ 150 descriptors) and plan.md specifies VIF pruning with an L1 fallback. Neither spec nor plan records this override — the task silently nullifies FR-007. Either implement the pruning/fallback or amend the spec/plan to record the override.

T107 'resamples the computed SHAP values (100 resamples, no dataset re-training per the ratified Plan Override)'. FR-005 requires bootstrapping the DATASET (sample size equal to full dataset) with re-derived top-SHAP rankings per resample. Resampling precomputed SHAP values is a materially weaker analysis not authorized by spec or plan; the 'Plan Override' is undocumented in either artifact.

FR-013/FR-001(c) require filtering features with |r| > 0.85 computed only on the training split before model training. No task implements this filter; T105's 'do NOT remove features' and descriptor_schema.schema.yaml's exclusion rule 'No high-correlation exclusion (features retained)' directly contradict the spec. Either add a train-split correlation-filter task or amend the spec.

concerns.location: tasks.md:coverage table vs spec.md:FR-010, FR-011, SC-008
concerns.text: FR-010/FR-011/SC-008 have no implementing task and are declared out of scope per Constitution Principle VI. The constitution conflict is real, but the spec (Status: Draft) still contains these requirements unamended, leaving a permanent spec↔tasks contradiction. The spec must be revised to remove/annotate FR-010/FR-011/SC-008; a tasks-side note (T111) cannot retire a spec FR.

SC-007 requires flexible-molecule detection reproducible across TWO independent heuristics (rotatable-bond ≥ 5 AND a torsional-flexibility score) with Jaccard ≥ 0.8. T101 implements only the rotatable-bond flag; no task implements the second heuristic or the Jaccard ≥ 0.8 check. Dropped acceptance criterion.

US-2 scenario 1 sets a concrete acceptance criterion: validation R² ≥ 0.10 exceeding the null baseline. T104's verification only checks that metrics are written to model_metrics.json; the R² ≥ 0.10 criterion is never checked or honestly reported as failed. Add it to T104's verification (with honest failure reporting, not threshold relaxation).

US-1 scenario 3 requires the descriptor matrix saved to disk within 15 minutes. No task records or verifies a preprocessing-stage runtime bound (T110 only checks the global ≤ 6 h budget). Add per-stage runtime logging/verification or amend the spec.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T101 vs spec.md:FR-009, US-3 edge case
concerns.text: FR-009 and the US-3 edge case require flexible-molecule outliers to be highlighted in downstream ERROR ANALYSIS. T101 only sets the flexible flag; no task performs error analysis on the flagged subset. Add an error-analysis step or explicitly descope in the spec.
